# Strings recovered from `JNI_OnLoad` by static replay

`JNI_OnLoad` (`0x2c5310`, 94,920 B) contains **1354** byte assignments of the
form `DAT_00a1xxxx = DAT_00a1yyyy <op> <const>` writing into `.data`
(`vaddr 0x915830..0x91653b`, file offset `0x90d830..`). The sources are
`.data` bytes with real on-disk content, so replaying the 1354 assignments
over the file image reconstructs the table without running anything.
**0 evaluation failures.** Below: every printable run of length >= 4.
